flows:
Navigate to https://revoke.cash then Do not connect a wallet or sign anything.
On the Revoke.cash home page, type the public address 'vitalik.eth' into the address search field and press Enter to open its approvals page without connecting a wallet.
Use the network selector to choose 'Ethereum' and wait for loading to finish so that the list of token approvals appears.
Open the sort dropdown and choose 'Newest to Oldest'.
Then open the filters control and apply one filter, for example the 'ERC20' token standard filter.
Never press 'Connect Wallet', 'Revoke', 'Revoke Selected', 'Update', 'Approve' or 'Confirm'.
Assert that the sort control shows the text 'Newest to Oldest', the applied filter's label is shown as active, and the approvals list displays rows of token approvals (or a visible 'No token approvals found' message).
